Add one "Done (2026-11-01)" line in the same shape: what it runs, which file it keeps, what it posts, and that Servex must restart to pick it up (law 9).

The first time `twins_daily` runs there is no `session-twins.json`, so all 1,408 existing twins count as new and Servex posts a risk note, "1408 sessions got a second folder… a writer went around SessionFolders" (diff.patch:630). That note is false: these twins are the old 2026-10-09 leftovers, still waiting for the fold. Fix: on the first run (no file yet), write the list without posting, or set `session-twins.json` up as part of landing.

A fresh agent can't land this from the task folder alone. `session.jsonl` stops after the docs commit (ebb9c5335): it never says the review is pending, never names the merge command, and has no "can it happen again: no, because …" line, all three of which the brief's Land fence asks for. It also doesn't record the order: merge, then `node Servex/sustain.mjs --restart` and a dev-server restart, then `SessionConsolidate.mjs --all --apply`. That order is written only in `doc/one-folder.md:768`. Add a next-steps log line.

`ChildLinks.sessions` no longer keys a tab-era flat task folder by its line-1 `assign.session_id` (diff.patch:81–83). The log says 69 ids were dropped and each was checked by hand. Any child whose parent link went through one of those folders now resolves to nothing, so it is worth one line in ChildLinks' header comment.

`AISessionIndex.dir_of` (diff.patch:692) skips `Session.locate`'s old step that moved a flat `<id>/` folder into its day. If any flat folders are still left directly under `sessions/`, index.json now goes to a new dated folder beside them. This is probably harmless (the move was a migration), but nothing says so.

`SessionFolders.all()` (diff.patch:979) trusts the saved map whenever every listed folder still checks out. A second folder made later by a writer that skipped the finder is only seen at the next miss or `twins()`. That is acceptable because the daily check exists for exactly this; just be aware of it.
Found during the work and not caused by it: `Server/AskIndex-tasks.test.mjs:22` also fails on the original `AskIndex.mjs` (session.jsonl, 17:02 log). File it as a task so it isn't lost.

Can it happen again: no, because every writer that names a session folder (DatedFiles.session_dir → TaskDirs, open_task, the SessionStart hook, prompt-relay; Session.locate → AISession.save, the page tool, PromptLog; AISessionIndex; ChildLinks; AskIndex; SessionIdentity; SessionConsolidate) asks one function, SessionFolders, which finds a session in ANY folder that holds its id (slug names too) and checks its answer on disk every call, so it never returns, and no writer re-makes, a folder that moved. What is left: a new writer that builds a path by hand would go around it, and two writers racing to make a brand-new session's first folder across midnight could pick two days; both are caught by the daily twin check (TaskLoop.twins_daily posts a risk note the day a new twin appears).
